# Knee Age — kneeage.com

> Knee Age is the biological age of your knees compared with your chronological age. The free 60-second Knee Age test at kneeage.com was designed by Dr Arj Imbuldeniya, Consultant Orthopaedic Knee & Hip Surgeon (FRCS Tr&Orth, 25+ years in orthopaedics), and scores five domains of joint health — Power (strength), Risk (genetic/family history), Injury (injury and load history), Movement (range and mechanics), and Endocrine & Metabolic (hormones, metabolism, inflammation) — known as the PRIME assessment. The result is a single Knee Age number you can compare with your actual age.

Key facts:
- The test is free, takes about 60 seconds, and shows the headline Knee Age instantly; no account is needed to start.
- It is a Class I wellness assessment, not a medical device or diagnosis; it does not replace clinical consultation.
- Knee Age is modifiable for most people: strength, body composition, sleep, nutrition and activity all shift it.
- Clinical philosophy: "Biology-first. Surgery-last." Around 90% of patients who came to Dr Arj's practice thinking they needed surgery didn't end up needing it (cohort 2016–2026).
- Clinical consultations are delivered at Lanserhof at The Arts Club (Mayfair, London) and Cromwell Hospital, London.
